Governance [ edit ] Rennington is in the parliamentary constituency of Berwick-upon-Tweed . From 1974 to 2009 it was in Alnwick district. Rennington was formerly a township and chapelry in the parish of Embleton, [ 2 ] in 1866 Rennington became a separate civil parish, on 1 April 1955 the parishes of Broxfield, Rock and Stamford were abolished and merged with Rennington.
